concerns.text: FR-001 (and many other FRs) reference a non‑existent identifier ‘US-1’ (e.g., “See US-1”). The specification only defines “User Story 1” but does not assign it an ID such as US‑1, causing cross‑reference resolution failures.
FR-003 (and several other FRs) reference ‘US-2’, which is not defined anywhere in the document; the second user story is titled “User Story 2” without an explicit US‑2 identifier.
FR-006 (and other FRs) reference ‘US-3’, which likewise lacks a defined identifier; the third user story is only labeled “User Story 3”.
